title: WAMR: Reveal deleted messages!
summary: Recover deleted messages, media, and regain control of your chats.
description:
See Deleted Messages with WAMR!

Ever wish you could see a deleted message? Searching for "wamr"? You've found the solution!

WAMR helps you recover deleted text messages and media attachments (photos, videos, voice notes, audio, GIFs, and stickers) from your chat apps. Stop wondering what was said and regain control of your conversations!

How WAMR works (for those searching "wamr")

WAMR leverages your notification history to create a backup of incoming messages. When a message is deleted, WAMR instantly notifies you and retrieves the content from its backup. It's a clever workaround for those frustrating disappearing messages!

NO MORE BLUE CHECKS

Since you now have a live backup of your notifications, this means that you can read entire chats, conversations without sending "read receipts" (blue check marks).
Welcome back privacy!

Recover Media Too!

WAMR also works for media! If someone deletes a photo, video, or any other media attachment before you see it, WAMR will notify you and attempt to recover it.

Important Considerations for WAMR Users

WAMR relies on notifications. For optimal performance:

* Enable Notifications: Ensure notifications are enabled for your messaging apps. Silent chats won't be recoverable.
* Battery Optimization: Prevent Android from closing WAMR in the background by excluding it from battery optimization settings.
* Download success: WAMR can only save media files that have been fully downloaded. A stable internet connection is recommended.

Things to Keep in Mind

WAMR offers a workaround for retrieving deleted messages, but it has limitations based on the messaging app, Android OS, and other factors. It's important to understand that retrieving messages deleted before WAMR was installed is not possible.

Privacy Focused

Your privacy is paramount. WAMR saves everything locally on your device. This means that no one else has access to your chats, notifications, messages,

STATUS DOWNLOAD

Status download is not supported anymore, apologies for the inconvenience.

Download WAMR now and never miss a deleted message again!
